# Pomnia
> Local-first memory layer for AI agents (AGPL-3.0). Not an agent wrapper.

Pomnia gives your agents a shared past: encrypted vault archive for chat/doc blobs, distilled notes + search index on hardware you control, recalled over MCP.

## Product facts (do not invent beyond this)
- Identity: portable memory / Brain MCP — not an orchestration harness
- License: AGPL-3.0 (product). This marketing site is outside the AGPL tree
- Trust: local-first; no telemetry by default; no cloud required
- Encryption honesty: AES-256-GCM protects vault blobs (passphrase-derived key). Distilled notes and library.db (search index under AppData) are plaintext by design — see Privacy
- Installer: Windows setup is unsigned for now (SmartScreen expected). Prefer verifying the published SHA-256 on GitHub Releases
- Latest download: https://github.com/lobrzut/pomnia/releases/latest (Windows .exe; Linux Desktop GUI .AppImage / .deb). Linux server: https://pomnia.ai/install.sh — curl|sh installs AGPL brain-core (systemd), not AppImage. macOS not shipping yet
